cost_memory_scope: Process-lifetime high-water RSS, including any inherited startup history; not incremental diagnostic memory or training memory.
limits: Same development rows influenced candidate choice; intervals are descriptive post-selection diagnostics, not independent confirmation.
One training seed cannot estimate training-seed variability;12 whole groups may still share residual dependence.
All22 task slices are retained; small slices and multiple comparisons are exploratory, with no per-slice significance tests or threshold changes.
No frozen references were scored here; frozen-base gain and three-seed release bounds are not inferred.
The original exposed256-row+4.18%NLL result is unchanged; these are different development rows.
Task labels replace raw questions; row, group and source identifiers are omitted. Group summaries retain every group without labeling an underlying event.
Relative changes for nearly zero slice NLL can look large while absolute differences are small; no task-slice significance tests are performed.
These observed differences do not diagnose a coding defect or establish a causal mechanism.
Sequence-length317–347 describes these scored development rows only; it is not a training-length measurement.
